basic_info.description: First Time on the Market! Spacious 1975 Gem on a Quiet Court. Nestled on a peaceful court street, this cherished 1975 home is being offered for the very first time. Lovingly maintained by the original owners, this detached-on-one-side residence sits on an oversized lot and offers a rare blend of space, comfort, and potential.    Step into a bright and inviting living room with a cozy fireplace and a large deck that frames sweeping viewsperfect for relaxing or entertaining. The formal dining room and sunny eat-in kitchen provide plenty of room for gatherings, while the main-level layout offers a natural flow for everyday living.   With 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, including a spacious primary suite, there's room for everyone. Downstairs, you'll find a generous 2-car garage, ample storage, and a chair lift providing seamless access across all three levels ideal for multi-generational living or future-proofing your forever home.    Enjoy the outdoors from your private back deck and yard, offering space to garden, play, or simply unwind. With its unbeatable location, thoughtful features, and untouched charm, this home is a rare opportunity to reimagine a classic in a coveted setting.
